title: Pomegranate, Rose and Mint Granita
changes_from_base: Pomegranate juice with a mint syrup and rose water replaces the strawberry purée.
summary: A refreshing frozen dessert combining tart pomegranate juice with delicate floral notes and a hint of fresh mint.

ingredients.item: dried edible rose petals, food-grade and unsprayed

steps.title: Syrup
steps.text: Combine 90 g caster sugar and 100 ml water in a small saucepan. Heat while stirring until the sugar is dissolved and the liquid reaches a boil.

steps.title: Infuse
steps.text: Add 3 sprigs of mint and simmer for 1 min on medium-low heat. Let the mixture cool for about 20 min, then strain through a sieve into a large bowl, pressing on the mint.

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: Whisk 400 ml pomegranate juice and ½ tsp rose water into the mint syrup. Pour the liquid into a shallow freezer container.

steps.title: First freeze
steps.text: Place the container in the freezer for 2-3 h until the edges are solid. Break up the ice with a fork and return to the freezer.

steps.title: Scrape
steps.text: Freeze for another 2 h and fork again to create crystals. Repeat this for 8-10 h in total until the mixture is completely frozen into fine shards.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Spoon the granita into small glasses. Scatter the 40 g pomegranate seeds and 2 tsp dried edible rose petals over the portions.

tips: Use a shallower container to help the mixture freeze into crystals more quickly.
Ensure you use only food-grade unsprayed rose petals for decoration.
Try using different varieties of mint for a subtle change in the aromatic profile.
storage: Keep the container covered in the freezer for up to 1 week and use a fork to break up the crystals before serving.
